description: Per-platform call deep-link URL patterns. Placeholder {id} is replaced with the platform call identifier (Retreaver: UUID = Calyx external_call_id). Override via NEXT_PUBLIC_*_CALL_URL_PATTERN env vars on the web app.

retreaver.notes: Case A confirmed: Call Log list shows truncated UUID; detail/URL use full UUID = Calyx external_call_id. Search must accept exact + prefix. Deep link https://retreaver.com/calls/{id}.
